scope: Runtime initialization, threading interface and the task queue operations exercised by the startup control. Unsupported runtime classes return E_NOINTERFACE.
checks: Initialize twice, release once, request the known interface and reject unknown class and interface IDs.
Duplicate a manual queue handle and close the original. Submit zero-delay work and delayed completion. Terminate, dispatch canceled work, dispatch termination, close and reject the stale handle.
Create a threadpool work and manual completion queue. Asynchronously terminate without a callback and verify an infinite-timeout completion dispatch returns.
Dispatch work through threadpool, serialized threadpool and immediate modes. Obtain and close a duplicate of the default process queue.
limitations: This control covers one runtime interface. User, account, platform storage, package and other service classes are outside its scope.
A console-side successful-path control for these internal entry points is outstanding.
reproduce: python build.py xgameruntime, then run build/xgameruntime/runtime-control.exe result.txt with the selected host.
